about: What this file is: the shot check for the Works' view W1 in No. 1's working state (round 5): the waiting men gone in (two of them now at its looms, inside the lit doorway), every window lit, the gate open and the three THIS WAY UP crates popped up in its gateway, as the film shows it from "things" on page 3 (paper-film/blender/inflation-chapter-2-newcomers/works/assemble_works.py, plan 34 part 1 'A. The Works'). The crates' lettering is in must_read, so the checker says if any of THIS WAY UP is hidden.
